answer_1.quote: We propose CHOOSE YOUR OWN ADVENTURE (CYOA), a protocol for pairwise evaluations of collaborative writing models, focusing on story generation.
answer_1.outputs: Story continuations (suggestions for the next line of a story)

answer_2.quote: We use three metrics to see how much of the original text is preserved after a writer's revisions. Levenshtein edit distance measures the number of character insertions, deletions, and substitutions the writers made, and Jaccard similarity measures the proportion of tokens that are shared between the original and the edited text. User Story Edit Ratings (USER) measures similarity by recursively counting the longest contiguous substrings between the edited and the original text.

answer_4.quote: We run CYOA on Amazon Mechanical Turk with 105 Turkers to compare the two models. After the finished story is submitted, participants are asked Likert-scale and open-ended questions about the system and the suggestions they received.
answer_4.guideline: Participants rated agreement on a 5-point Likert scale for statements including happiness with the story, collaboration, usefulness of suggestions, connection to story context, and idea generation; they also answered open-ended questions about reasons for choosing suggestions and expectations.
